bundles.name: CachyOS Layer
bundles.author: Ryoku Team
bundles.description: Turn Ryoku into CachyOS: the performance-tuned kernel, cachyos-settings tuning, sched-ext schedulers, the ananicy-cpp auto-nice daemon and ruleset, and the CachyOS Proton build. Adds the CachyOS repos above Arch's, so opting in goes full CachyOS; the stock kernel stays as the boot fallback. Install all, or pick individual tools. Every item but scx-scheds needs the CachyOS repo.

components.name: linux-cachyos
components.summary: The CachyOS kernel: EEVDF with sched-ext, Clang ThinLTO and AutoFDO, the Cachy patchset, x86-64-v3. Needs the CachyOS repo; not on plain Arch.

components.name: linux-cachyos-headers
components.summary: Headers for the CachyOS kernel, needed to rebuild DKMS modules (NVIDIA, VirtualBox) against it. Needs the CachyOS repo; not on plain Arch.

components.name: cachyos-settings
components.summary: CachyOS system tuning: sysctl, udev, modprobe and systemd defaults for a responsive desktop. Needs the CachyOS repo; not on plain Arch.

components.name: ananicy-cpp
components.summary: Auto-nice daemon that reprioritizes processes so the compositor and foreground apps stay responsive under load. From the CachyOS repo (AUR on plain Arch).

components.name: cachyos-ananicy-rules
components.summary: The CachyOS ruleset ananicy-cpp applies. Needs the CachyOS repo; not on plain Arch.

components.name: scx-scheds
components.summary: sched-ext userspace schedulers (bpfland, rusty, lavd). In Arch extra, so it runs on plain Arch too; it just shines on the CachyOS kernel.

components.name: proton-cachyos-native
components.summary: The CachyOS-tuned Proton build for Steam and Lutris. Needs the CachyOS repo (and multilib for its 32-bit libraries); not on plain Arch.
